outfit.name: 垂褶飘带真丝衬衫与侧开衩黑裙
outfit.prose: A flowing midnight navy silk blouse featuring an elegant pussy-bow necktie that drifts over the chest, paired with a high-waist black crepe maxi skirt cut with a daring thigh-high side slit. The slit reveals a sheer black stocking leg secured with a refined silver chain thigh garter, finished with glossy Mary Jane pumps.
